hushgram.title: v0.0.18
hushgram.body:
HushGram moves to Instagram 453.0.0.57.79 and Morphe patcher 2.1.0, so you'll need Morphe Manager 2.3.0 or newer. Feed videos and reels can stop looping, feed videos get a seek bar, and a reel can show its whole picture with black bars instead of being cut off. Carousels can have arrows, chats can be pinned or exported as text, and a viewing history can stay on your phone. Among the fixes, `Tab bar layout` and `Hide Featured in notifications` work on Instagram 453 again, and `Pure black dark mode` now reaches the startup screen and HushGram's own settings.

New in this release

- `Stop videos looping` is a new patch under Playback. Feed videos and reels stop on their last frame instead of playing again. Reels still loop while auto scroll is on, so it can move on. It starts off. Asked for in #248 and #175.

- `Hide Subscribe on profiles` and `Hide the arrow at the end of the buttons` are new under Profiles. The other buttons fill the row, and the arrow's menu goes with it. Both start off. Asked for in #248.

- `Skip the contacts and location popups` is a new patch. With its switch on under Ads and privacy, the screens asking you to sync contacts and turn on location stop opening at every start. It starts off. Asked for in #295, #329 and #421.

- `Emoji style` gets `Emoji pack` under Layout. Keep your phone's emoji, download Twemoji, OpenMoji or Blobmoji, or pick a color emoji font, then restart Instagram. A pack only switches in once its download checks out. Asked for in #166.

- `Smooth story opening` is a new patch under Stories. A story you tap in the stories row zooms open more slowly and stops without the little bounce at the end, and it closes the same way. It starts off. Asked for in #409.

- `App-only proxy` is a new patch under Ads and privacy. Type an HTTP proxy's address and port in `Proxy server`, restart, and only Instagram goes through it. It takes plain HTTP proxies that need no password. Starts off. Asked for in #219.

- `Copy text button on reels` and `Copy text button on stories` add a Lens icon that opens Google Lens on the reel or story to copy its words. Without the Google app it opens the share sheet. Both start off. Asked for in #303.

- `Ambient light in stories` is a new switch under Stories. A story that doesn't fill the screen gets a soft glow in its own colors in the black bands, and it changes with each photo or video. Starts off. Asked for in #420.

- `Ambient light` is a new patch under Feed, off to start. Posts in Home and Following glow softly in their own colors, and so do the bands around a reel that doesn't fill the screen. Asked for in #416.

- `Carousel arrows` is a new patch. Its switch under Feed puts a back and a next arrow on a carousel post, so a tap moves to the next photo or video without swiping. It starts off. Asked for in #417.

- `Carousel arrows` gets `Page dots on a pill`, a new switch right under the arrows. A carousel's page dots move onto a round pill at the bottom, with your page in blue. Starts off. Asked for in #419.

- `Keep Home's top bar` gets `See-through top bar`, a new switch right under it. Home's top bar turns to frosted glass and your posts show through it as they scroll, whether the bar stays or slides away. Needs a restart. Asked for in #418.

- `Hide ads` now hides the ad that shows up among a post's or reel's comments too. Asked for in #415.

- In `Stop Reels scrolling`, `Stop after 20 reels` is now `Stop after a set number of reels`. Sliders pick the count (5 to 100) and how long Instagram sits in the background before swiping works again (5 to 120 minutes). Asked for in #405.

- `Keep a viewing history` under Ads and privacy keeps a list of the posts, reels, stories and profiles you looked at, on this phone only. `Clear viewing history` empties it. Starts off. Asked for in #228.

- The `App icon` list now shows each choice's real icon in its own colors next to its name, with the one in use marked, so you can see what you're picking before you leave Instagram. Asked for in #321 and #327.

- The `Accent color` list on Android 11 and older marks the color in use again.

- On Android 11 and older, `Material You` now stays in the `Color` list, greyed out, with the reason on it. Before, it just wasn't there. Asked for in #187 and #264.

- `Clean up Reels` adds `Start every reel in clear mode` under `Keep clear mode on`, so reels open in clear mode with no tap. Instagram blocks screenshots there unless `Allow screenshots` is on. Starts off. Asked for in #138.

- `Icons in the accent color` is a new switch under `Accent color`, off to start. After a restart the top bar, profile, tab bar and post icons take your color. Text keeps its own. Asked for in #8.

- `Explore without personalization` is a new patch for the EU, where Instagram offers that grid. One switch under Explore opens it every time. Another hides its menu button. Both start off. Asked for in #311.

- `Keep Featured off the heart's dot` under Notifications stops a Featured item from lighting the red dot on the heart. Likes, comments and follows still do. Starts off. Asked for in #189.

- `Pinned chats` under Messages pins the chat you opened last to the top of your inbox. Pins stay on this phone, per account, and the same row unpins them. Asked for in #345.

- `App icon` adds Hand-drawn Instagram, a pencil sketch of Instagram's glyph on white. Themed icons show the same sketch. Asked for in #406.

- `Chat history tools` is a new patch. Its switch under Messages lets you long press a chat's name to jump to its first message or a date, loading older messages with a count and Cancel. Starts off. Asked for in #246.

- `Chat history tools` gets a second switch, `Export a chat as text`. Long press a chat's name and pick Export chat to save the whole chat to Downloads/HushGram, one line per message. Starts off. Asked for in #247.

- `Save comment photo` gets a second switch under Comments, `Reply with a comment's GIF`. A comment's menu gets a row that sends its GIF back as your reply, animated. Starts off. Asked for in #402.

- `Use the highest refresh rate` is a new patch. Its switch, under Layout, asks Android to run Instagram at your screen's fastest refresh rate at the same resolution. It takes effect the moment you flip it, no restart. Starts off. Asked for in #401.

- `Read messages without the seen receipt` gets a switch, `Mark a chat seen when you reply`. Replying lets that person see you read their earlier messages. Chats you don't answer stay unseen. Starts off. Reported in #365.

- `Hide captions` is a new patch. Its switch, under Feed, takes the caption off feed posts and reels and leaves the post. The comments sheet still shows it. Off to start. Asked for in #395.

- `Keep Home's top bar` is a new patch. Its switch under Feed keeps the Instagram logo and its buttons at the top of Home while you scroll. Restart Instagram after you flip it. Starts off. Asked for in #408, #367 and #223.

- `Keep the Reels top bar` is a new patch. Its switch, under Reels, keeps the Reels title, the Friends tab and the buttons beside them at the top while you swipe through reels. No restart needed. Starts off. Asked for in #411.

- `Mark one-time photos and videos` is a new patch. Its switch, under Messages, puts a border and Instagram's view once icon on one-time photos and videos in a chat. Only the look changes. Starts off. Asked for in #165.

- `Pinch to zoom on Reels` is a new patch. Its switch, `Pinch to zoom` under Reels, lets two fingers zoom into a playing reel the way a photo zooms, and it goes back when you lift them. Starts off. Asked for in #382.

- `HushGram settings` adds `Descriptions behind an info button` under Settings entry. It shows each switch by name alone, with a small i to tap for what it does. Off to start. Asked for in #130.

- `Swipe through a chat's reels` adds `Stop after the chat's reels` under Messages, which ends reels you open from a chat at the last one shared there. No suggested reels follow. Starts off. Asked for in #390.

- In `Download any video`, Copy media link under Details now says the link stops working after a few days, since Instagram's file addresses expire. Asked for in #364.

- `Download any video` adds `Never save AV1 video` under Downloads, for a phone that plays AV1 badly. A video Instagram has at full size only as AV1 is saved as VP9, or at its largest H.264 size. Starts off. Asked for in #379 and #348.

- `Download any video` adds `Never save HDR video` under Downloads. An HDR-only video is saved at its largest standard size instead, so it skips the yellow or green cast some apps give HDR. Starts off. Reported in #352.

- `Seek bar on feed videos` is a new patch. A bar along the bottom of the video playing in your feed lets you drag to any point in it. The switch is under Feed and starts off. Asked for in #389.

- In `Glass tab bar`, `Blur strength` and `Tab bar opacity` under Tab bar are sliders (2 to 48 dp, 0 to 150 percent), and the pill follows as you drag. Both start at the old look. Older backups still restore. Asked for in #391.

- When Instagram crashes in the first minute after it opens, HushGram now keeps what crashed, and the diagnostics report you save from `HushGram settings` includes it. Turn on Debug logging to keep later crashes too.

- `Group Instagram's notifications` adds `Mute notification types` under Notifications. It stops the types you tick, like the betting and promo pushes Instagram's own notification settings can't turn off, and works with grouping off. Nothing's muted to start.

- `Lock your messages` adds `Fingerprint or face only` to Unlock with under Messages, on Android 11 and up. Its prompt has no PIN, pattern or password. Remove every fingerprint and face and your screen lock unlocks again.

- `Full screen Reels and Home` adds `Show the whole reel` under Reels. Every reel fits inside the screen with black bars where its shape differs, so nothing's cut off at the sides. Starts off.

- `Skip the collections tray` is a new patch. With its switch on under Feed, saving a post or reel shows Instagram's Saved message instead of the tray that asks you to start a collection. Starts off.

- `Hide the Reels tab` adds `Settings button on Home's header` under Tab bar. A gear at the top of Home opens HushGram settings with one tap. Starts off. Asked for in #404.

- `Download any story` adds `Download button on stories` under Stories. A button at the top of a story, beside the three dots, saves the photo or video in front with one tap. Starts off. Asked for in #400.

- `Start reels with sound` adds `Start reels muted` under Playback. Every reel starts silent, even from a link or a notification, and the volume keys or speaker icon unmute it. Starts off. Asked for in #342.

- `View live anonymously` adds `Mark as seen button on lives` under Stories. While you watch a live anonymously, an eye beside the three dots puts you on that live's viewer list when you tap it. Starts off. Asked for in #412.

- `Glass tab bar` adds `Bend light at the edges` under Tab bar. With `Liquid glass look` on, the pill's rim bends what passes under it the way real glass does, on Android 13 and up. Starts off. Asked for in #369.

- `Glass tab bar` adds `Run Reels behind the tab bar` under Tab bar. The reel fills the screen behind the pill, with its caption, buttons and seek bar just above it. Starts off. Asked for in #372.

- `Clean up Reels` adds `Hide suggested searches on reels`, `Hide shopping buttons on reels` and `Hide poll prompts on reels` under Reels. Each takes its prompt away from beside the reel's author. All three start off. Asked for in #332.

- `Start Home on Following` adds `Fall back to Following` under Feed. When For you brings an account only suggested posts, page after page, Home opens on Following for that account. A feed you pick stays picked. Starts off. Asked for in #308.

Fixes

- `Instagram logo on Home` works without `Start Home on Following` now. Turned on, the logo stays put as you scroll instead of switching to "Home" and flashing blank in between. Reported in #413.

- `Turn off HDR brightness boosts` also stops the brighter white Instagram 452 and later give some reels on phones with HDR headroom, like the Galaxy S25 FE. Reported in #85 and #26.

- `Full size covers` asks for covers up to 1440 pixels wide now. It used to stop at 1080, and some picked covers are 1290 wide. Reported in #214.

- Turning `Full size covers` on or off now reaches reels you'd already opened. Instagram keeps the cover sizes it was sent across restarts, so the first start after a change now drops those saved answers. Reported in #214.

- `Hide Featured in notifications` works on Instagram 453 again, Threads suggestions included. Featured rows were back at the top of Notifications. Reported in #259.

- With `Hide the Muse card`, the Meet Muse card stays off Home and your profile when Instagram sends it some other way. It still showed up now and then. Reported in #294.

- With `Pure black dark mode`, a story now opens straight on black. It flashed Instagram's dark blue for a moment first. Reported in #360.

- With `Pure black dark mode`, the screen Instagram shows while it starts up is black in dark mode too. It stayed dark gray. Reported in #410.

- With `Gray out stories you've watched`, your own `Your story` now stays first in the tray, ahead of the watched stories pushed to the back. Before, it could end up among them. Reported in #241.

- With `Pure black dark mode`, HushGram's own settings cards and dialogs are black now. They stayed dark gray. Reported in #374.

- With `Glass tab bar` and `Hide the tab bar on Reels`, a reel fills the screen again once the pill slides away. It left a black band where the pill had been. Reported in #335.

- A save that comes out in lower quality because your phone's storage is low now says so in its toast, and a carousel's summary counts how many. It used to blame only Instagram's quality. Reported in #348.

- With `Tab bar layout`, picking Classic or Swipe under Tab bar works on Instagram 453 again. On 0.0.17 it changed nothing, since the patch was answering an Instagram setting the tab bar never reads. Reported in #356.

- With `Tab bar layout`, a long press on the classic bar's Search tab opens search with the keyboard up again. Instagram 453 waited for pages only the swipe bar has, so the press just switched to Explore. Reported in #383.

- `Full screen Reels and Home` makes room for the status bar on a profile again. With `Full screen Reels` on, going back from a reel you'd opened there left the person's name behind the clock. Reported in #385.

- Typing fast in the `HushGram settings` search keeps every letter. The list used to take the focus from the field while it filtered, so a letter could go missing or come out twice.

- With `Gray out stories you've watched` on in `View stories anonymously`, a story you've just watched keeps its place in the tray until you pull down to refresh. It used to jump right the moment you closed it. Reported in #377.

- On Instagram 453, `See who a story mentions` puts its pill just under the story's header, lined up with the name. In the name row it pushed the name up into the progress bars. Reported in #405.

- With Hide shopping on in `Hide suggested posts`, Explore no longer leaves blank squares where a shop tile was. A shop tile inside a bigger block now takes the whole block out, so the grid closes up. Reported in #393.

- `Show all recent searches` now lists every recent search on accounts where Instagram builds the search screen the newer way. Those still stopped at five. Reported in #375.

- `Swipe through a chat's reels` makes a second tap on a post or reel in a chat wait for the first to open. On a slow phone each extra tap opened another copy. Reported in #390.

- With `Logo and titles at the start` and `Hide Create on Home's header` both on, Instagram's logo no longer touches the screen's left edge. It keeps the gap the heart has on the other side. Reported in #407.

- With the `Glass tab bar` pill floating, coming back to Reels from a reel's profile no longer lays the Reels screens out again. That second layout could leave the video stuck on its cover while the sound kept playing. Reported in #378.

- `See who a story mentions` no longer cuts the account's name short. When the name's row can't fit the pill, like on a highlight with a full date, the pill moves just under the header. Refs #405.

Other changes

- In Morphe Manager, `Ask before a like` and `Long press to zoom` now sit under Interaction beside `Change the like animation`, which keeps the Feed group short. Their switches are still on the Feed settings page.

- `See who a story mentions` opens its list again when you come back from an account's profile, so you can go down the list without reopening it each time. Close ends it. Asked for in #403.

- HushGram now patches Instagram 453.0.0.57.79 instead of 453.0.0.55.79. Get APKMirror's (arm64-v8a) (480-640dpi) (Android 9.0+) variant, build 385914557. Its armeabi-v7a (385914556) and x86 (385914558) builds are declared too. Meta published no x86_64 build this time.

- Manager lists `Keep a seek bar on Reels` under Playback now, next to `Seek bar on feed videos`, and the Reels group gets one row shorter. Its switch is still under Reels.

- Manager lists `Start feed videos with sound` and `Keep the reel speed` under Playback now, out of the long Feed and Reels groups. Their switches haven't moved.

- In `Download any reel`, Download audio's line in the diagnostics report says when a reel's only sound is xHE-AAC, which some players can't play. The file is still saved as it is, never re-encoded. A follow-up to #216.

HushGram moves to Instagram 453.0.0.57.79 and Morphe patcher 2.1.0, so you'll need Morphe Manager 2.3.0 or newer. Feed videos and reels can stop looping, feed videos get a seek bar, and a reel can show its whole picture with black bars instead of being cut off. Among the fixes, `Tab bar layout` and `Hide Featured in notifications` work on Instagram 453 again, and `Pure black dark mode` now reaches the startup screen and HushGram's own settings.

New in this release

- `Stop videos looping` is a new patch under Playback. Feed videos and reels stop on their last frame instead of playing again. Reels still loop while auto scroll is on, so it can move on. It starts off. Asked for in #248 and #175.

- `Hide Subscribe on profiles` and `Hide the arrow at the end of the buttons` are new under Profiles. The other buttons fill the row, and the arrow's menu goes with it. Both start off. Asked for in #248.

- `Skip the contacts and location popups` is a new patch. With its switch on under Ads and privacy, the screens asking you to sync contacts and turn on location stop opening at every start. It starts off. Asked for in #295, #329 and #421.

- `App-only proxy` is a new patch under Ads and privacy. Type an HTTP proxy's address and port in `Proxy server`, restart, and only Instagram goes through it. It takes plain HTTP proxies that need no password. Starts off. Asked for in #219.

hushpinterest.title: v0.0.13
hushpinterest.body:
HushPinterest 0.0.13 has 33 patches for Pinterest 14.41.0. It's the first one built on Morphe patcher 2.0.0, so update Morphe Manager to 2.0.0 or newer before you patch. Older Manager builds can't open this bundle.

The new patch is GmsCore support, for phones that run microG-RE instead of Google Play services. It sends Pinterest's Google sign-in and push notifications through microG-RE. It isn't picked by default, so if you don't use microG-RE nothing changes for you.

Patch 14.41.0 with the same signing key you used before and install it over your current HushPinterest. Your settings stay as they are.

## What's new

- New GmsCore support patch, for phones that run microG-RE instead of Google Play services. Pinterest's Google sign-in and push notifications go through microG-RE, so Continue with Google opens microG-RE's sign-in. Before, it asked Play services and the account got turned down. It's left out of the default selection since without microG-RE those requests have nowhere to go. Pick it in Expert mode and Spoof signature for Google sign-in comes along with it. (#15)
- The patches are now built on Morphe patcher 2.0.0, so you'll need Morphe Manager 2.0.0 or newer to apply them. Older Manager builds can't load the bundle.

## Behind the scenes

- A release can't go public until the whole app has been walked with that exact bundle on a release phone or an emulator. The publish stage now takes the walk's receipt as `-Walk` and stops before GitHub or the index if the walk wasn't a full pass, saw a Pinterest crash, ran on some other device, or patched with a different bundle.
- A device lease another session happens to be reading no longer stops a run partway. The check waits a moment and tries again, and a lease that stays locked still stops it.
- New `scripts/walk-app.ps1` patches Pinterest from the release bundle and installs it on a leased phone or emulator. Then it opens the home feed, the patched screens and every Hush settings page, and writes the receipt publish asks for. Only a full walk with no Pinterest crash earns a PASS.

## Install

1. Install [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) 2.0.0 or newer.
2. Add HushPinterest as a patch source: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushPinterest
3. Download Pinterest 14.41.0, version code `14418010`. APKMirror has it as an arm64-v8a bundle (`.apkm`) for Android 12L or newer. Pick that file in Manager and it merges the parts before patching.
4. Uninstall the stock Pinterest first, since Android won't put one over the other. Save anything you keep only on the phone before you do. Your boards and pins come back when you sign in.
5. Sign in with your email and a Pinterest password. If you joined through Google or Facebook, tap `Forgot your password?` on Pinterest's login page to set one first. On a phone with microG-RE, pick GmsCore support when you patch and Continue with Google goes to microG-RE's sign-in instead.
6. Right after your first patch, export Morphe Manager's signing key (Settings, then System, then Import & export, then Signing key) and keep it somewhere private. Updates only install over a Pinterest signed with that same key.

hushtelegram.title: v0.0.23
hushtelegram.body:
HushTelegram v0.0.23 has 67 patches for the Google Play build of Telegram 13.1.1 (`org.telegram.messenger`, version code 72371) and telegram.org's Telegram 13.1.0 (`org.telegram.messenger.web`, version code 72299). It's on Morphe patcher 2.1.0 like 0.0.22, so Morphe Manager 2.3.0 or newer still loads it. Nearly all of it came from your reports again, and it changes something for #9, #29, #39, #41, #45, #48, #49 and #50. Calls can be recorded to a file on your phone, and a record button on the call screen does it for just the call you're on. View-once and timed photos and videos can stay in the chat after you open them, or get copied to Download/Telegram. Ghost mode can hide typing and your online status now. With UnifiedPush, reaction notifications can play a sound and name custom emoji, and turning UnifiedPush on also switches on Telegram's own background connection so messages arrive while the app is closed. New switches start off, except the Ways in ones, which keep every way into the HushTelegram settings open until you change them.

New in this release

- `Ghost mode` has two more parts, `Hide typing` and `Hide online status`, both off by default. With Ghost mode and `Hide typing` on, people in a chat don't see that you're typing, recording a voice message or sending a file, in secret chats too. With `Hide online status` on, Telegram isn't told that you're online while you use it. Going offline still goes out, so your account shows as offline when you leave. The diagnostic report counts what each one kept back. (#45)

- `UnifiedPush notifications` has a new switch, `Sound for reaction notifications`, off by default. Telegram keeps every reaction notification silent. Turn it on and they play the sound and vibration you picked in Telegram's Notifications and Sounds > Reactions. (#41)

- Reaction notifications with `UnifiedPush notifications` now cover custom emoji reactions too. Once Telegram has loaded that emoji on your phone, the notification names the regular emoji it stands for. (#41)

- `Disable call debug upload` has a new switch, `Record calls`, off by default. Turn it on and every call is saved on your phone as one .m4a file with both sides in it, named for when the call began, in Recordings/Telegram calls (Music/Telegram calls on Android 11 and older). Voice chats and live streams you're in get saved the same way. The other person isn't told. On Android 9 it needs Telegram's storage permission. (#39)

- `Record button on calls`, off by default, puts a round record button on the call screen right under the minimize arrow. Tap it to record just the call you're on. With `Record calls` on, the button starts out red and a tap skips recording that one call, keeping what was already recorded. It hides along with the rest of the call screen's buttons, and the choice ends with the call. (#39)

- A new `Ways in` section on the HushTelegram settings page has a switch for each way to open them, all on by default. They are the HushTelegram row on Telegram's Settings page, a long press on the Telegram title in the chat list, the row in the side menu, and the shortcut in the menu you get from holding Telegram's icon. A way you turn off acts like stock Telegram. The row, the long press and the side menu entry are gone, and the shortcut is taken off the launcher, pinned copies included. One way always stays on so you can get back in, and turning off the last one puts the switch back with a short message. No restart needed. `Lock HushTelegram settings` holds these switches like the rest. (#29)

- `Save downloaded files` has a third switch, `Also save view-once and timed media`, off by default. With it on, view-once and self-destructing photos, videos, voice messages and video messages get copied to Download/Telegram once they download, readable like any other file. Secret chats stay in Telegram whatever the switches say. From a chat that doesn't allow saving, `Also save from chats that don't allow saving` has to be on as well. (#9)

- `Keep deleted messages` has a new switch, `Keep view-once and timed media`, off by default. Turn it on and a view-once or self-destructing photo, video, voice message or video message someone sends you stays in the chat after you open it. There's no countdown, and you can open it again as often as you like. Secret chats work as usual. Timed media you send stays on your phone too. (#9)

Fixes

- With `Hide reactions under messages` on, TalkBack no longer reads out reactions you can't see. A message reads the same as one nobody reacted to, and Saved Messages tags are still read since they still show. (#48)

- Leaving `Message times with seconds` out in Morphe Manager now really leaves it out. `Keep deleted messages` used to pull the whole patch back in, so its switch still showed in the Hush settings. Now it takes along only the part it needs to mark a message deleted. (#49)

- With `UnifiedPush` on, Hush now also turns on Telegram's own `Keep-Alive Service` and `Background Connection` once your push app hands over its address, so messages come in while Telegram is closed instead of when you next open it. It only does that if you never set either switch yourself, and the notification report says what turned them on. (#50)

Behind the scenes

- The whole-app walk opens and closes the new `Ways in` section as well. Left off the walk's list, Ways in read as more rows of Updates, and the walk failed because Updates never looked closed. A contract test now holds the walk's sections to the ones the settings home draws, in the same order.

- The whole-app walk gets past Android asking for contacts or photos over the screen it's opening. It says no (Don't allow, or Not now on Telegram's own contacts prompt, never Allow or Continue) and opens the screen again. If the ask keeps coming back, the walk's problem line names it instead of a bare "would not open".

- The release build stage writes down how long the full gate took, the same way preflight already does, so a slow gate shows up next to the earlier timing.

- Release preflight runs the pre-push hook's check for tracked files that name the maintainer's machine or a phone. Everyday pushes skip that hook, so one such name sat in a build script comment on main until the contract tests read it.

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushTelegram/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too.

How to update

1. Install [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) 2.3.0 or newer. That's the same floor as 0.0.22, so if you patched that one you're set.
2. Add HushTelegram as a patch source: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushTelegram
3. Get the right Telegram. From Google Play that's 13.1.1 (`org.telegram.messenger`, version code 72371), which [APKMirror](https://www.apkmirror.com/apk/telegram-fz-llc/telegram/) and Uptodown also carry. From telegram.org's [Download button](https://telegram.org/android) it's 13.1.0 (`org.telegram.messenger.web`, version code 72299). The patched app needs Android 9 or newer.
4. Coming from 0.0.22? Patch the APK of the same build you're on and install it over your current HushTelegram with the same Morphe Manager signing key. Your settings and chats stay. New to HushTelegram? Uninstall the stock Telegram first, since Android won't put a patched app over one signed with a different key. Your chats come back when you sign in, but secret chats don't. Back up Morphe Manager's signing key after your first patch. You'll need it for every update.
5. If Telegram turns down your login code with `API_ID_PUBLISHED_FLOOD`, that's Telegram refusing the public API ID that ships with any patched build, the Play one included. Register your own app at [my.telegram.org/apps](https://my.telegram.org/apps), using only letters and numbers in the short name. Then select `Use registered Telegram API credentials`, fill in `apiId` and `apiHash`, and patch again. The result installs over your current HushTelegram build. Keep both values private.
6. Want HushTelegram's own icon, or Telegram's logo in white on the black launch screen? Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager and pick `HushTelegram icon and name` or `Black and white launch logo` before you patch.
7. For notifications, open Telegram's Settings, tap Notifications, and turn on `Keep-Alive Service` and `Background Connection` under Other, near the bottom of the page. On phones where Firebase notifications don't come through, try the `UnifiedPush notifications` switch on HushTelegram's Notifications page with a UnifiedPush app like ntfy. It turns those two on for you unless you've set them yourself.
8. To change HushTelegram's switches, open Telegram's Settings and tap HushTelegram settings, or press and hold the Telegram title at the top of your chat list. The new Ways in section on that page decides which of those (plus the side menu row and the icon shortcut) stay.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Telegram APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushTelegram#install).

What was checked

All 1728 runtime tests passed locally, and all 564 patch tests passed too (162 unit tests and 402 that patch the real Telegram APKs), along with both Android lints (the shared library and the Telegram extension). Every one of the 67 patches applied without forcing to telegram.org's Telegram 13.1.0 (version code 72299) and to the Google Play build of 13.1.1 (version code 72371). For each patched build the release receipt checked the package name, version, manifest, native libraries and zip alignment.

Both builds were patched from this exact bundle and installed over the HushTelegram already on a Galaxy S22, without clearing its data. Both were signed in to Telegram. On each one the walk opened Telegram's Settings, Privacy, Folders and Themes pages and a channel, then every section of the HushTelegram settings (the new Ways in section too) and the Changed switches page. That's 22 screens per build, with no crash and no problem found on either.

* **Discord - View raw data:** Fixed long lines being impossible to scroll sideways when Wrap lines is off ([#145](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/145))

* **Discord - Keep media playing:** Fixed the notification staying after returning to Discord with buttons that did nothing ([#145](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/145))
* **Discord - Keep media playing:** Fixed a video in the small window resetting, losing its place and coming back with an off-center play button ([#145](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/145))
* **Discord - Expand the message bar:** Fixed the post header in threads and forum posts covering the open bar's collapse button ([#145](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/145))
* **Discord - Show timeout duration:** Fixed the timeout tag lagging behind and saying 1m for a whole minute instead of counting down ([#145](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/145))

* **Discord - Remove anything:** Fixed removal marks spilling past New Group, covering the channel details tab labels and header buttons
* **Discord - Read all button:** Fixed muted servers being skipped, so their channels stayed unread after tapping Read all
* **Discord - Read all button:** Fixed the debug log filling up with a line every time the server bar scrolled past the button, pushing out everything useful
* **Discord - Custom branding:** Fixed Custom branding being selected by default when adding the source, so patching installed a renamed second copy of Discord
* **Discord - Send long messages:** Fixed spoilers, `>>>` quotes and inline code breaking when a long message was cut into parts, showing hidden text in the clear
* **Discord - Send long messages:** Fixed a cut landing inside a custom emoji, mention, link, flag or joined emoji, leaving broken text in both parts
* **Discord - Send long messages:** Fixed long forum posts and scheduled message edits skipping Discord's length check and then being refused when sent
* **Discord - Send long messages:** Fixed a sticker sent with long typed text being refused, losing both the sticker and the text
